title: wedelia ramagii
intro: Wedelia ramagii, commonly known as the 'Narayanam' or 'Kali Musli', is a type of flowering plant in the sunflower family. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, making it effective in treating various health conditions such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Wedelia ramagii include its antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-hyperlipidemic activities, which contribute to its potential in managing chronic diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
